messages.subject: Re: Can I convert mod@Data$tabdatalong data to polytomous type data?
parts:
Something like this?

library(mirt)
mod <- mirt(Science, 1)

long <- extract.mirt(mod, 'tabdatalong')
K <- extract.mirt(mod, 'K')
cats <- do.call(c, lapply(K, function(x) 1:x))

t(apply(long, 1, function(x){
    ret <- cats * x
    ret[ret != 0]
} ))

extract.mirt(mod, 'tabdata') #compare

Phil
